answer: I would stop farms with mediation by a rotating senior grader pool, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. One honest agent clears the check in 17 minutes; a farm of 704 pays 11968 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The vine test is the live device, the sable test is the locked stake, and the haven test is the graded history no template can fake. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
